pages.title: Blank Carriers
pages.text: Blank jade slips and paper formula scrolls carry formula knowledge rather than finished pills. Both media can use the catalog consumable path to inscribe a matching formula carrier.

pages.title: Inscription Sources
pages.text: Using a blank jade slip or paper formula scroll rolls a registered non-sect formula carrier for that medium. Sect-secret formulas are never rolled from blanks; inscription fails when no matching carrier is registered.

pages.title: Study Knowledge
pages.text: Use a dedicated formula item to record persistent formula knowledge on the server. Studying does not consume the carrier, and a duplicate study is rejected while leaving the original item available for furnace installation.

pages.title: Knowledge at the Furnace
pages.text: An alchemy furnace accepts either an installed formula item or the same formula already studied by its owner. Formula media adjust controlled success and explosion risk; study only satisfies the formula gate and does not bypass the shell, lid, fire, realm, skill, ingredient, or earth-fire-room checks.

pages.title: Persistence and Limits
pages.text: Study records live in the player's persistent data and copy with player cloning, while legacy aliases normalize to the current recipe id. Recipe contents remain server data-pack authority; client text cannot invent formula knowledge.
